verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents idempotency keys or duplicate-suppression semantics on Postmark's send endpoints (/email, /email/batch, /email/withTemplate). The only 'idempotency pattern' mentioned (postmark-docs-10) is part of webhook receiver setup, which protects against reprocessing incoming events, not against double-sending on retry. The 'retry' API (postmark-docs-47) applies to inbound message processing, not outbound sends.
